integrity: Finite counts were obtained with a fully specified sixteen-bit orientation certificate and independently exhaustive literal-word enumeration. Arithmetic and sources are reproducible; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The optimizer census applies to binary contiguous five-mers. The minimum length twenty and a particular optimal half-cycle were already published. The all-odd-order closure lemma is general, but no infinite optimizer-count formula is asserted. A previously unindexed equivalent table remains possible.
title: Exact enumeration of shortest binary reverse-complement five-mer covers
